answer: A fresh alias is hence worth nothing for 14 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. Farming becomes a juniper bet on surviving 119 epochs of grading, and every anchor settlement recomputes the jade schedule, so an farming party who quits early keeps almost nothing. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 119 epochs rather than arriving at once. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
